_method: SQL template reconstructed from the ORM call chain (not EXPLAIN output), per the app_issues/list precedent; table/column names follow db/models/intake.py; byte-identity pinned by PIDASHCONV-90 GET intakes/ + inboxes/ shape tests

handler.empty: list returns Response(IntakeSerializer(None).data) — null body with 200; the port must reproduce the null, not a 404
handler.response: first row only, rendered via IntakeSerializer (key order in serializers/intake.golden.json)

sql: SELECT "intakes".*, COUNT("issue_intake"."id") FILTER (WHERE "issue_intake"."status" = -2) AS "pending_issue_count" FROM "intakes" INNER JOIN "workspaces" ON ("intakes"."workspace_id" = "workspaces"."id") WHERE ("workspaces"."slug" = %s AND "intakes"."project_id" = %s AND "intakes"."deleted_at" IS NULL) GROUP BY "intakes"."id" ORDER BY "intakes"."name" ASC LIMIT 1
sql_notes: COUNT joins the intake_issues related manager issue_intake; the FILTER counts only PENDING (-2) rows
deleted_at IS NULL comes from SoftDeletionManager on every objects access
ORDER BY name ASC is the model Meta.ordering; LIMIT 1 is .first()
